tools.name: echo
tools.title: Echo
tools.description: Echo the input text back to the caller. Useful for verifying MCP connectivity.

tools.name: qa_whoami
tools.title: QA whoami / health
tools.description: Read-only QA-MCP health probe. Returns booleans and gate status only. Does not read business data, secrets, JWTs, or DB rows.

tools.name: qa_probe_users
tools.title: QA probe users
tools.description: Read-only preflight: sign in each configured QA test user via publishable key, verify role and reference links under that user's JWT, then sign out. Never creates users, never mutates roles, never returns tokens.

tools.name: qa_probe_fixtures
tools.title: QA probe fixtures
tools.description: Read-only preflight: validates QA_MCP_FIXTURES_JSON when set, or discovers suitable reference/master fixtures and returns suggested_fixtures_json. Uses service_role via a SELECT-only wrapper. Never mutates reference/master data.

tools.name: qa_probe_primitives
tools.title: QA probe primitives
tools.description: Read-only preflight. Calls only known safe read-only RPCs with their real signatures — rpc_resolve_country({p_input}), rpc_resolve_product_exact({p_query,p_include_reserve}), has_role({_user_id,_role}), current_import_manager_id() — with no-op arguments. Table/view existence via SELECT ... LIMIT 0 through the SELECT-only wrapper. Mutating RPCs are DECLARED but NEVER executed in this no-write Build; catalog_exists is reported as "unknown" because no safe existing catalog-read path is available.

tools.name: qa_run_shipment_smoke
tools.title: QA run shipment smoke
tools.description: QA-ONLY write-and-cleanup harness. Runs the real shipment lifecycle end to end (offer → branch response → take into work → shipment + item + child shipment on same vehicle) under actor JWTs, then returns captured_ids for qa_cleanup_run. Never uses service_role. Never returns tokens.

tools.name: qa_direct_dogruz_no_offer
tools.title: QA direct dogruz without offer
tools.description: QA-ONLY write scenario. Creates a direct open vehicle shipment with import manager 1, then creates a second direct shipment by import manager 2 inside the same open vehicle. No offer, no branch response, no VS, no reserve, no close. Returns captured_ids for qa_cleanup_run. Never returns tokens.

tools.name: qa_cleanup_run
tools.title: QA cleanup run
tools.description: QA-ONLY: delete rows created by a previous qa_run_shipment_smoke run, using its captured_ids payload. Deletes only by captured ids, in reverse dependency order. Idempotent — safe to rerun. Never touches reference/master data. Never uses date-based filters.
